NousResearch/hermes-agent.summary: Hermes Agent is an AI agent system featuring a learning loop that creates and improves skills based on user interaction and session experience. It supports multiple communication platforms including Telegram, Discord, and Slack, and can be deployed across local, cloud, and serverless environments.
highlights: Built-in learning loop for autonomous skill creation and memory management.
Supports seven execution backends including Docker, SSH, and Vercel Sandbox.
Integrated cron scheduler for natural language task automation.

NousResearch/Hermes-Function-Calling.summary: Hermes-Function-Calling provides a framework for the Hermes Pro Large Language Model to execute specific tasks through structured tool use. It utilizes a recursive loop to generate function calls, execute them via Python scripts, and process the returned data. The repository supports both standard function calling and JSON mode inference using Pydantic models for schema validation. Users can extend the system by integrating custom functions and tools, such as financial data retrieval via the yfinance library.
highlights: Supports function calling and JSON mode inference
Allows custom tool integration via Python scripts
Uses Pydantic for structured JSON schema validation

NousResearch/hermes-agent-self-evolution.summary: Hermes Agent Self-Evolution is a framework for the automatic improvement of Hermes Agent's capabilities. It utilizes DSPy and Genetic-Pareto Prompt Evolution (GEPA) to optimize skills, prompts, and code through reflective evolutionary search. The system analyzes execution traces to propose targeted mutations without requiring GPU training. All evolved variants are subject to strict guardrails, including test suites and size limits, before undergoing human review via pull requests.
highlights: Optimizes skills and prompts using DSPy and GEPA
No GPU training required; operates via API calls
Strict guardrails including full test suites and size limits

NousResearch/hermes-paperclip-adapter.summary: The hermes-paperclip-adapter is a bridge that integrates Hermes Agent into the Paperclip company management system as a managed employee. It functions by wrapping the Hermes CLI, parsing raw terminal output into structured transcript entries and clean markdown for the Paperclip UI. This allows the agent to respond to task assignments and issue comments while utilizing its native suite of 30+ tools and persistent memory. The adapter also manages session state, skill synchronization, and multi-provider inference settings directly within the Paperclip environment.
highlights: Integrates Hermes Agent as a managed employee in Paperclip systems
Parses raw CLI output into structured tool cards and markdown
Supports 8 inference providers including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter

NousResearch/autonovel.summary: Autonovel is an autonomous pipeline designed to generate complete, print-ready novels from a seed concept. It employs a modify-evaluate-keep/discard loop across four phases, moving from world-building and drafting to automated revision and final export. The system integrates a dual-persona review process using Claude Opus to refine prose and structure. The pipeline can produce a variety of final formats, including PDFs, ePubs, audiobooks, and landing pages.
highlights: Multi-phase pipeline from seed concept to print-ready PDF/ePub
Dual-persona review loop using Claude Opus for literary critique
Integrated art generation and ElevenLabs multi-voice audiobook production

outsourc-e/hermes-workspace.summary: Hermes Workspace is a comprehensive command center designed to orchestrate AI agents through a unified web interface. It integrates with the vanilla hermes-agent to provide a zero-fork environment for managing chat, memory, and system operations. The platform features a Swarm Mode that utilizes tmux-backed workers for autonomous, role-based task dispatching and a Kanban board for tracking progress. Users can manage over 2,000 skills, browse MCP catalogs, and access a cross-platform PTY terminal from a single dashboard.
highlights: Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers
Integrated memory browser, skills manager, and MCP catalog
Full workspace file browser with Monaco and PTY terminal

fathah/hermes-desktop.summary: Hermes One is a community-maintained native desktop app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. It uses the official Hermes install script, stores Hermes in `~/.hermes`, and provides a GUI for chat, sessions, profiles, memory, skills, tools, scheduling, and messaging gateways.
highlights: Uses the official Hermes install script.
Provides a GUI for managing profiles, sessions, skills, and tools.
Available from the project website or GitHub Releases.

sanchomuzax/hermes-webui.summary: Hermes WebUI is a graphical dashboard designed to monitor and manage the Hermes Agent ecosystem. It utilizes a FastAPI backend and a React frontend to interface with the agent's existing data files via a WebSocket-based polling bridge. This approach allows for real-time visibility into sessions, costs, and scheduled jobs without requiring modifications to the core agent code. Users can inspect conversation histories, manage skills, and view system configurations through a responsive interface.
highlights: Real-time dashboard for session activity and cost tracking
Full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code
Read-only monitoring of configuration and environment variables

Euraika-Labs/pan-ui.summary: Pan is a self-hosted web dashboard and workspace designed specifically for the Hermes Agent runtime. It provides a centralized interface to manage agent interactions through a chat-first environment that supports SSE streaming and tool timelines. Users can discover and install skills from skills.sh, manage MCP integrations, and organize work into isolated profiles with unique memory and sessions. The system includes a setup wizard that automatically detects Hermes configurations and can run as a background daemon or system service.
highlights: Chat-first workspace with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards
Integrated marketplace for discovering and installing skills and MCP servers
Isolated profile management for separate sessions, memory, and API keys

mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills.summary: Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills is an open-source library containing 818 structured cybersecurity skills designed for AI agents. The repository maps these skills across six industry frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and MITRE ATLAS, following the agentskills.io open standard.
highlights: Contains 818 structured skills across 34 security domains.
Maps skills to MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, D3FEND, and F3 frameworks.
Compatible with over 26 AI platforms.

conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing.summary: avoid-ai-writing is a portable writing skill for compatible AI agents that audits and rewrites English prose to address AI-writing patterns. It offers rewrite, detect-only, and in-place editing modes, with optional voice profiles and a bundled detector that can score files or piped text from the command line.
highlights: Three modes: rewrite, detect, and edit prose in place
Optional profiles: casual, professional, technical, warm, or blunt
Command-line detector supports files and piped text

wondelai/skills.summary: Wondelai Skills is a library of 65 agent skills and metaskills compatible with agentskills.io-compliant agents, including Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. The library provides expert frameworks based on industry style guides and books, alongside guided metaskills that maintain state in a project's docs folder to orchestrate tasks across sessions.
highlights: Includes 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills.
Compatible with Claude Code, Codex, and agent-plugins.org specifications.
Maintains session state within the project's docs folder.

DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills.summary: pydantic-ai-skills is a companion package for pydantic-ai-harness that enables remote skill registries and bundled-file execution for Pydantic AI agents. It implements progressive disclosure, allowing agents to load full instructions, reference documents, and scripts only when a specific task requires them.
highlights: Supports remote skill registries via Git and S3 sources.
Provides tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts.
Includes sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host.

Agents365-ai/drawio-skill.summary: drawio-skill is an Agent Skills-format skill that turns natural language descriptions and sources such as Terraform, Kubernetes, SQL DDL, and codebases into editable .drawio diagrams. It supports incremental synchronization that preserves manual layout, architecture rules enforced in CI, and export to formats including HTML, PowerPoint, Mermaid, and Markdown. It runs through a CLI called diagramctl, with an optional MCP server for MCP hosts.
highlights: Generates editable .drawio files from prompts and real sources
Incremental sync preserves manual layout and annotations
CLI diagramctl with optional MCP server

smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills.summary: This repository collects official Chainlink coding skills, each following the Agent Skills specification. It lists nine skills covering areas such as CRE, CCIP, Data Feeds, Data Streams, ACE, VRF, and a confidential AI attester. Skills can be installed with the vercel skills CLI, either at project level or globally with the -g flag.
highlights: Nine Chainlink skills listed, each following the Agent Skills spec
Install via npx skills add smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills
README states repo contains community examples only

tlehman/litprog-skill.summary: The litprog-skill is a Claude Code extension that implements Donald Knuth's literate programming paradigm by transforming codebases into human-readable narratives. It works by generating a .lit.md file that weaves together prose, Mermaid diagrams, and LaTeX math with the original source code. The tool includes a tangler to extract runnable files and a reverse-sync engine to ensure the documentation stays updated when source files are edited. This approach helps developers document architectural decisions and facilitates easier onboarding through structured, essay-like code explanations.
highlights: Generates .lit.md files combining prose, diagrams, and source code
Extracts runnable source files from documentation using a tangler
Automatically syncs source file edits back to the literate document

esaradev/icarus-plugin.summary: Icarus is a Hermes plugin that provides agents with shared memory and a pipeline for creating replacement models. It captures agent decisions and work into a markdown-based directory, allowing different agent profiles to access a common knowledge base. This captured data is then filtered by quality and exported as training pairs for fine-tuning cheaper models via Together AI. Users can evaluate these candidate models and switch to them once they meet specific performance thresholds.
highlights: Cross-instance shared memory via markdown files
Automated capture of high-value decisions and outcomes
Pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models

chigwell/skilldock.io.summary: SkillDock is an OpenAPI-driven Python SDK and CLI for interacting with the SkillDock API. It enables users to search, install, and manage skill releases, and supports commerce flows via TON.
highlights: Provides a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI
Supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution
Includes commerce features using TON payments

black-forest-labs/skills.summary: BFL Skills provides tools to teach coding agents how to prompt FLUX models and integrate with the BFL API following the agentskills.io specification. The project includes specialized modules for image prompting best practices and a suite of video generation skills.
highlights: Supports FLUX image and video generation prompting
Includes BFL API integration for polling and webhooks
Provides a FLUX 3 video suite with eight specialist skills

Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory.summary: Skill Factory is a meta-skill for Hermes Agent that automates the creation of reusable skills by monitoring user workflows. It functions by tracking session patterns in the background and proposing structured skill definitions when it detects repeatable sequences. Users can generate both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds directly from these proposals via slash commands or natural language. This tool streamlines the expansion of the Hermes ecosystem by turning manual environment setups and development tasks into permanent, executable assets.
highlights: Automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows
Generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds
Provides slash commands to manage, list, and save detected patterns

ReinaMacCredy/maestro.summary: Maestro is a local-first coordination system for human and agent collaboration that stores work, decisions, and sessions in a repository's Git root. Written in TypeScript and running on Bun, it uses a mechanism kernel to manage a SQLite store and event log without requiring a background service.
highlights: Uses a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage and event logging.
Coordinates agent teams through the SLP cooperative-agent protocol.
Distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills.

tiann/execplan-skill.summary: ExecPlan is an Agent Skill designed to help AI coding agents autonomously manage complex, long-running implementation tasks. It utilizes a structured execution plan that allows users to review and approve the approach before implementation starts. The system tracks progress in real-time and provides rollback procedures for safe recovery. It is compatible with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Goose.
highlights: Autonomous execution for long-running tasks
Real-time tracking of progress and decisions
Built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery

cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill.summary: Agentic-MCP-Skill is an experimental MCP client designed to reduce token consumption through a three-layer progressive disclosure pattern. It implements a socket-based daemon architecture that allows AI agents to load server metadata, tool lists, and specific tool schemas incrementally rather than all at once. This approach aims to optimize context window usage and improve the efficiency of managing multiple MCP servers.
highlights: Three-layer progressive loading to minimize token usage
Socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections
Incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas

armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge.summary: Skill Forge analyzes code repositories, documentation, and developer discourse to create instruction files for AI agents. Its workflows can produce skills with source citations or documentation URLs, test them, and export them.
highlights: Creates agent instructions from repositories, docs, and developer discourse
Supports automated and step-by-step skill workflows
Includes skill testing and export

amanning3390/hermeshub.summary: HermesHub is an ARD-compliant agent registry that enables the discovery and indexing of AI agent capabilities. It utilizes a Hermes Agent to autonomously crawl, validate, and index manifests hosted at /.well-known/ai-catalog.json endpoints. Users can list agents for free via self-publishing or through a paid hosted listing that includes health checks. The platform supports ranked discovery via a standardized search API and maintains federation with Hugging Face Discover and GitHub Agent Finder.
highlights: Full implementation of Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification
Autonomous 24/7 operation via Hermes Agent on NVIDIA infrastructure
Federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face

PederHP/skillsdotnet.summary: SkillsDotNet is a C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io standard designed to integrate agent skills into the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It uses a skill:// URI convention to implement progressive disclosure, allowing clients to discover lightweight skill metadata before loading full documentation or supporting files. The library provides seamless integration with Microsoft.Extensions.AI and supports automatic discovery of skills from various agent directories like Claude, Cursor, and Copilot.
highlights: Implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files
Integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading
Supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories

mem0ai/mem0.summary: Mem0 is an intelligent memory layer designed to provide AI assistants and agents with personalized, long-term context. It utilizes a multi-level memory architecture—covering User, Session, and Agent states—and employs a single-pass extraction algorithm with temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. The project is available as an open-source SDK via pip and npm, a self-hosted Docker deployment, or a managed cloud platform.
highlights: Supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states
Features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval
Available as OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud

vectorize-io/hindsight.summary: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to help agents learn over time, not only recall conversation history. It provides retain, recall, and reflect operations for storing information, searching memories, and generating responses, with clients for Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go.
highlights: Offers retain, recall, and reflect operations.
Provides Python, Node.js/TypeScript, and Go clients.
Supports multiple LLM providers, including local options.

greyhaven-ai/autocontext.summary: autocontext is a harness for agent improvement: it runs a goal against evaluation, keeps useful lessons, and discards dead ends. It leaves traces, reports, playbooks, and other artifacts that can be inspected, replayed, or used in later runs.
highlights: Runs tasks against evaluation
Keeps useful lessons and discards dead ends
Leaves traces, reports, and playbooks

elkimek/honcho-self-hosted.summary: This project provides a configuration layer for self-hosting Plastic Labs' Honcho memory backend, enabling cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent without relying on third-party cloud storage. It deploys the full Honcho stack—including the API, PostgreSQL with pgvector, and Redis—on local hardware using Docker Compose. Users can route memory extraction and reasoning tasks through any OpenAI-compatible API or local inference servers like Ollama to maintain data sovereignty. This setup allows Hermes to build long-term user profiles and logical observations while keeping conversation data on the user's own infrastructure.
highlights: Enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent via self-hosting
Supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers
Includes automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis

yoloshii/ClawMem.summary: ClawMem is an on-device memory layer for Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes, and other AI agents, with retrieval-augmented search, hooks, and an MCP server. It uses a local SQLite vault and supports importing conversation exports from Claude Code, ChatGPT, Claude.ai, Slack, and plain text.
highlights: Combines BM25, vector search, rank fusion, and cross-encoder reranking.
Generates session handoffs and captures decisions and preferences.
Integrates through hooks, MCP, and native agent plugins.

plur-ai/plur.summary: PLUR is a local-first memory layer for AI agents that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk, shared across MCP tools such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It installs via npm packages @plur-ai/cli and @plur-ai/mcp, requires Node.js 20 or newer, and runs search locally after a one-time model download. The README reports retrieval recall of 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S with its default hybrid stack.
highlights: Stores agent memory as plain-text YAML engrams on disk
Local search after one-time model download; keyword fallback
README reports 95.6% R@5 on LongMemEval-S (N=500)

amanning3390/flowstate-qmd.summary: FlowState-QMD is a local-first memory layer designed to provide coding agents with immediate project context from markdown documentation. It utilizes a SQLite-based vector store and an anticipatory cache that prefetches relevant documents by monitoring active agent session logs. This approach allows agents to access design docs, ADRs, and changelogs before initiating a reactive search loop. The system integrates via an MCP server and supports local execution using GGUF models and node-llama-cpp.
highlights: Anticipatory cache prefetches context by watching agent session logs
Local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp
MCP-native server with automated configuration for major coding agent clients

robbyczgw-cla/hermes-web-search-plus.summary: Web Search Plus is a Hermes plugin that adds tools to search the web and extract clean text from pages. It connects multiple search and extraction providers, can route searches by query type, and can try another provider when one fails or returns no results.
highlights: Adds web_search_plus and web_extract_plus tools.
Supports automatic provider routing and fallback.
Works with one configured search or extraction provider.

42-evey/hermes-plugins.summary: Evey's Hermes Plugins is a collection of 23 custom extensions designed to enhance the autonomy, observability, and cost-efficiency of the Hermes Agent framework. The suite implements specialized logic for multi-model decision debates, smart task routing with fallback chains, and structured telemetry logging. These tools enable agents to manage their own goals, perform self-correction loops, and consolidate long-term memory into vector storage. Additionally, the project includes a bidirectional bridge for Claude Code and budget enforcement via Langfuse integration.
highlights: Autonomous planning, reflection, and multi-model consensus debate tools
Smart model routing with sensitivity filters and four-model fallback chains
Automated memory consolidation into Qdrant vectors and identity evolution

FahrenheitResearch/hermes-weather-plugin.summary: The Hermes Weather Plugin provides a suite of 13 meteorological tools for the Hermes Agent ecosystem, enabling real-time access to observations, forecasts, and high-fidelity model imagery. It utilizes a Python-first architecture that offloads heavy computational tasks, such as NEXRAD radar rendering and ECAPE calculations, to high-performance Rust backends. The plugin features an automated bootstrap process that compiles necessary Rust binaries on first use, ensuring a streamlined setup for complex weather analysis. Users can retrieve verified model soundings, severe weather outlooks from the SPC, and global data via Open-Meteo integration.
highlights: Thirteen tools for NWS forecasts, radar imagery, and severe weather alerts
Rust-backed meteorological calculations for ECAPE, soundings, and parcel profiles
Automated bootstrap system for compiling and caching required Rust binaries

42-evey/evey-bridge-plugin.summary: The Evey Bridge Plugin is a technical integration that connects Claude Code with the Evey hermes-agent stack. It functions by automatically checking for messages or tasks from the bridge and injecting them as context into every prompt submission. The plugin includes specialized commands for running a 'Mother Mode' improvement loop and monitoring system health, including wallet and cron status. It is designed specifically for users running the Evey stack at a designated local directory.
highlights: Injects Evey messages and tasks into Claude Code prompts
Automates Mother Mode improvement loops via the /evey-loop command
Monitors health, wallets, and crons with quick status checks

nativ3ai/hermes-payguard.summary: Hermes PayGuard is a security-focused plugin that enables Hermes Agents to handle USDC and x402 payments through a gated execution model. It separates payment preparation from execution by requiring an out-of-band human approval stamp for transfers exceeding user-defined policy limits. The system supports Circle developer-controlled wallets, cross-chain CCTP transfers, and automated x402 micropayments for paid HTTP fetches. This architecture ensures that while agents can stage financial intents, they cannot unilaterally move significant funds without explicit operator consent.
highlights: Enforces human-in-the-loop approval for high-value USDC transfers
Supports Circle CCTP for cross-chain USDC routing and execution
Automates x402 micropayments below configurable policy thresholds

builderz-labs/mission-control.summary: Mission Control is a self-hosted, alpha-stage control plane for operating and governing AI agents. It provides a local dashboard backed by SQLite to dispatch tasks, track token spend, and coordinate agent runtimes such as Claude Code and OpenClaw.
highlights: Governs tasks, agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking.
Provides Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API interfaces.
Supports local installation via Node.js or deployment using Docker.

swarmclawai/swarmclaw.summary: SwarmClaw is a self-hosted runtime and framework designed for managing autonomous AI agent swarms and orchestrators. It utilizes a multi-agent architecture featuring delegation, scheduling, and durable memory to coordinate complex workflows. The platform supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates with MCP tools and various CLI backends. It serves as a centralized dashboard for visualizing agent teams and managing multi-agent AI operations.
highlights: Supports 23+ LLM providers including OpenAI and Ollama
Features durable agent memory and MCP tool integration
Provides visual org charts for agent team delegation

howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness.summary: Hermes Agent Meta-Harness is a standalone outer-loop optimizer designed to improve LLM system quality by optimizing the code that manages context and retrieval. It functions by treating the Hermes Agent as an execution backend and performing structured searches and mutations over harness candidates. The tool facilitates automated benchmark evaluation, baseline comparison, and frontier tracking for verifiable coding tasks. It is specifically configured to target benchmarks like TBLite and TerminalBench-2.
highlights: Automates outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code
Orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 benchmark evaluations
Provides structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking

runtimenoteslabs/gladiator.summary: Gladiator is an autonomous agent arena that pits two AI companies against each other to compete for GitHub stars on identical repositories. The system uses Paperclip for orchestration and Hermes Agent workers to execute tasks according to distinct corporate strategies: growth-focused Blitz versus quality-focused Craft. A real-time dashboard visualizes the competition through scoreboards, task boards, and audit trails. Upon completion, the project demonstrates cross-company skill transfer by merging the rival entities and their learned memories.
highlights: Orchestrates 9 autonomous agents across two competing AI companies
Uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning
Real-time dashboard visualizes agent tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics

1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent.summary: Hermes is a multi-agent orchestration system for OpenCode AI that coordinates 17 specialized agents to handle software development tasks. The system uses a pipeline architecture to manage processes such as research, planning, implementation, quality, documentation, and infrastructure.
highlights: Coordinates 17 specialized AI agents
Uses a strict pipeline architecture
Includes a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination

numtide/llm-agents.nix.summary: llm-agents.nix provides a collection of Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools, updated automatically on a daily basis. The repository includes terminal-based pair programmers, agentic IDEs, and CLI tools for various AI platforms and models.
highlights: Provides Nix packages for AI coding agents and development tools.
Automatically updated daily.
Includes tools for terminal, desktop, and IDE environments.

TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw.summary: HermesClaw is a community implementation that runs the Hermes Agent inside an NVIDIA OpenShell sandbox to provide hardware-level security enforcement. It utilizes kernel-level mechanisms like Landlock LSM and Seccomp BPF to restrict network egress, filesystem access, and dangerous system calls. This architecture allows the agent to maintain its full capability stack while ensuring that rogue skills are stopped by the operating system. Users can manage security postures through policy presets ranging from strict inference-only to permissive web and messaging access.
highlights: Hardware-enforced sandboxing via NVIDIA OpenShell
Kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access
Configurable security policies for messaging and web search

0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent.summary: nix-hermes-agent provides a Nix package and NixOS module for the declarative deployment of Hermes Agent. It allows users to manage the entire agent lifecycle—including configurations, workspace documents, and systemd services—through a single Nix configuration file. The module features a robust update policy that uses quarantined candidate pull requests to prevent broken upstream releases from affecting stable deployments. It also supports secure secrets management by keeping API keys and authentication tokens outside of the Nix store.
highlights: Declarative configuration for cli-config.yaml and workspace documents
Hybrid skill management supporting both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills
Secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix

xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker.summary: This project provides a minimal Docker sandbox image designed to package and deploy Hermes Agent. It utilizes the official upstream installation script to set up the agent and includes mini-swe-agent within the container. The image supports multi-arch publishing and allows for persistent state management by mounting the agent's home directory. Users can easily build specific versions using build arguments to target different Hermes branches or tags.
highlights: Includes mini-swe-agent and official Hermes installation
Supports persistent state via mounted home directories
Allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments

JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server.summary: This project provides a deployment framework for running Hermes Agent as a persistent, headless Linux service. It utilizes systemd to manage the Hermes Gateway, ensuring the agent remains active across reboots without requiring an open terminal session. The setup integrates with the Nous Portal for model access and leverages the native Hermes cron scheduler to automate recurring AI tasks. This approach offers a stable, self-hosted alternative to manual shell loops or third-party hosting for autonomous server operations.
highlights: Configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service
Enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs
Supports headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers

teknium1/hermes-miniverse.summary: Hermes-miniverse is a bridge that enables Hermes Agents to inhabit and interact within Miniverse pixel worlds. It functions through a three-part architecture consisting of a standalone bridge daemon, a gateway hook for state broadcasting, and a specific skill that allows the agent to consciously navigate the environment. This integration allows agents to maintain a visual presence, update their status in real-time, and engage in bidirectional communication with other AI entities. Users can deploy multiple bridges simultaneously to populate a virtual world with specialized Hermes instances.
highlights: Connects Hermes Agents to Miniverse pixel-based virtual environments
Synchronizes live agent states including working, thinking, and idle
Enables bidirectional messaging between Hermes and other world agents

Ridwannurudeen/hermes-council.summary: Hermes Council is an MCP server designed to provide an adversarial judgment layer for Hermes Agent to prevent overconfident or unsafe autonomous actions. It functions by employing multiple specialized personas—such as Advocate, Skeptic, and Arbiter—to deliberate on plans, code diffs, and claims. This structured deliberation produces explicit verdicts including risk assessments, required checks, and verified evidence. The toolset also supports RL workflows by extracting DPO preference pairs and normalized rewards.
highlights: Provides adversarial preflight reviews for high-stakes autonomous actions
Stress-tests implementation plans and code diffs for potential failures
Generates structured verdicts and DPO preference pairs for RL training

gizdusum/hermes-blockchain-oracle.summary: Hermes Blockchain Oracle is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides Hermes Agent with real-time access to the Solana blockchain. It functions as a bridge between natural language queries and on-chain data by exposing specialized tools for wallet, token, and transaction analysis. The server enables users to monitor network health, track whale movements, and manage NFT portfolios through conversational interactions. By integrating directly with Solana RPC nodes, it eliminates the need for manual block explorer searches.
highlights: Provides real-time Solana wallet balances and token portfolio tracking
Detects large-scale whale transfers with configurable movement thresholds
Retrieves NFT metadata, collection details, and floor price information

junhoyeo/tokscale.summary: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard for tracking token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It reads usage data from the local storage locations of supported clients, including Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and others. Users can also run `bunx tokscale@latest submit` to submit usage data to a leaderboard and create a public profile.
highlights: Tracks token usage and costs across AI coding agents
Reads data from each client's local storage paths
Offers a submit command for leaderboard and public profile

joeynyc/hermes-skins.summary: Hermes Skins provides custom visual themes for the Hermes CLI agent to customize its terminal user interface. Users can apply these themes by adding YAML configuration files to their local Hermes directory. The skins modify visual elements like banner colors, ASCII art, and spinner animations without altering the agent's core behavior. This allows users to personalize their terminal experience with various aesthetics ranging from retro CRT to cyberpunk styles.
highlights: Customizes banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art banners
Supports YAML-based configuration for easy theme creation
Includes diverse themes like retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics

AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC.summary: hermes-CCC is a port of the Hermes Agent framework specifically designed for the Claude Code native skill system. It integrates the Hermes brain architecture directly into the Claude Code execution context, eliminating the need for external processes or OAuth authentication. The project implements 46 core skills across categories such as MLOps, software development, and research, including specialized tools for RL training and vector database management. This allows developers to utilize Hermes-style memory, personas, and task routing while remaining within a unified terminal environment.
highlights: Port of Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to CCC
Runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth
Includes MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training

unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser.summary: Vessel is an open-source web browser built on Chromium that integrates a sidebar AI assistant for tasks such as research, form filling, and page navigation. It features a supervisor interface that allows users to monitor real-time AI actions, approve sensitive operations, and undo recent changes.
highlights: Built-in support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Ollama, and other AI providers.
Supervisor sidebar for managing agent approvals, checkpoints, and conversation threads.
Supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows.

Abruptive/Ankh.md.summary: Ankh.md is an open-source framework designed to transform a single Hermes Agent into multiple specialized, project-specific instances. It works by detecting a local `.agent/` directory and dynamically overriding the default `hermes` command with a scoped agent configuration. This allows developers to maintain unique instructions, skills, and memories for different codebases or workflows without cross-project interference.
highlights: Per-folder scoping with local configuration and skills
Seamlessly switches between default and scoped Hermes agents
Supports project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions

0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes.summary: openclaw-to-hermes is a Python-based migration tool designed to transfer agents, workspaces, and configurations from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent. It maps model settings, credentials, and markdown-based memories while creating backups and supporting dry-run previews.
highlights: Migrates SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives to Hermes.
Maps OpenClaw configs and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats.
Sets up systemd gateway services and handles nested auth structures.

42-evey/evey-setup.summary: Evey Setup is a bootstrapping tool designed to quickly deploy a complete autonomous AI agent stack based on hermes-agent. It uses a series of bash scripts to automate the installation of Docker containers, model routing, and community plugins. The system integrates a variety of services including LiteLLM for model proxying, Ollama for local inference, and Qdrant for vector memory. Users can choose between three deployment tiers—Base, Services, or Full—to balance resource usage with available functionality.
highlights: Automated installation of hermes-agent and 12+ supporting services
Three scalable deployment tiers from minimum viable to production stack
Support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories

ucsandman/DashClaw.summary: DashClaw provides policy checks and approval workflows for AI agent actions. Its Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes hooks, OpenClaw gateway, and `dashclaw_invoke` can block calls before execution; SDK, API, and ordinary MCP integrations rely on callers to honor the verdict. Pending actions can be resolved through its approvals inbox, CLI, phone PWA, Telegram, or Discord, with decisions recorded for later review.
highlights: Supports Node and Python SDKs, REST, and multiple agent runtimes.
Includes prompt-injection scanning and policy-based approvals.
Can be run locally or self-hosted.

Lethe044/hermes-incident-commander.summary: Hermes Incident Commander is an autonomous SRE agent designed to detect, diagnose, and remediate production infrastructure incidents. It operates either as a plugin for Hermes Agent or as a standalone watchdog on Linux hosts using an Anthropic API key to provide triage and automated healing.
highlights: Monitors CPU, memory, disk, and failed systemd units.
Supports automated remediation and adaptive, time-of-day-aware thresholds.
Integrates with PagerDuty, Slack, Discord, and Microsoft Teams.

Christabel337/job-scout-agent.summary: Job Scout Agent is an autonomous tool that fetches job listings from multiple APIs and scores them against user skills and preferences. It performs company research and saves results into organized folders and a CSV tracker.
highlights: Fetches jobs from live job board APIs
Scores listings against user skills and preferences
Updates a CSV tracker for Google Sheets

rodmarkun/anihermes.summary: AniHermes is a natural language media server that simplifies the process of downloading and tracking anime. It leverages the Hermes Agent for LLM-driven tool orchestration to manage library tasks through conversational interfaces on Telegram, Discord, or the CLI. The system integrates with qbittorrent for downloads and Anilist for watchlist synchronization. Users can perform complex actions like identifying anime from screenshots via vision analysis or scheduling automatic weekly downloads.
highlights: Natural language control via Telegram, Discord, and CLI
Automated downloads using qbittorrent and Anilist synchronization
Vision-based anime identification from uploaded screenshots

JackTheGit/hermes-ai-infrastructure-moni.summary: This project is a reference implementation for building autonomous, long-running monitoring systems using Hermes Agent. It utilizes cron-based workflows to ingest AI research from arXiv and track infrastructure repositories on GitHub. The system automatically generates structured markdown reports covering compute risk analysis, cost projections, and trend dashboards. It serves as a template for developers to deploy headless, scheduled agents that transform raw research data into actionable infrastructure intelligence.
highlights: Automated research ingestion via arXiv API and GitHub ecosystem tracking
Scheduled cron workflows for risk analysis and cost modeling
Generates terminal-style dashboards and structured markdown intelligence reports

bigph00t/hermescraft.summary: HermesCraft is an embodied AI framework that integrates Hermes agents into Minecraft as persistent, interactive players. It connects the Hermes agent stack to a Mineflayer bot body through a custom Minecraft CLI and HTTP API, allowing agents to perceive and interact with the game world. Agents can function as individual companions or as part of multi-agent civilizations with private messaging and social memory. The system emphasizes fair-play perception by restricting agent knowledge to line-of-sight visuals and directional audio rather than using privileged game data.
highlights: Embodied agents with persistent memory, identity, and tool-use capabilities
Fair-play perception system using line-of-sight filtering and spatial mapping
Multi-agent social features including public chat and private messaging

hxsteric/mercury.summary: Mercury is a blockchain cash flow analyzer and Hermes Agent skill designed to provide transparency into wallet activities across Ethereum, Base, and Solana. It utilizes parallel subagents to fetch transaction data, identify six specific fraud patterns, and generate AI-driven trading strategies based on wallet behavior. The project features a multi-layer WebGL and Canvas dashboard for real-time visualization of inflows, outflows, and risk metrics. It operates as a standalone tool or an integrated Hermes skill for automated multi-chain investigations.
highlights: Analyzes transaction flows across Ethereum, Base, and Solana chains
Detects six fraud patterns including mixer interactions and dust attacks
Visualizes data via interactive WebGL and Canvas-based dashboards

bryercowan/hermes-embodied.summary: Hermes Embodied is a robotics extension for Hermes Agent that enables autonomous fine-tuning of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models through natural language. The system orchestrates a self-improvement loop by collecting robot trajectories in simulation or hardware, provisioning cloud GPUs via Vast.ai, and retraining models when performance thresholds are met. It integrates with the LeRobot framework and MuJoCo simulation to automate the transition from data collection to model promotion. This allows users to manage complex robotics training pipelines without manual machine learning expertise.
highlights: Automates VLA fine-tuning loops using natural language commands
Provisions and manages Vast.ai cloud GPU instances autonomously
Supports SmolVLA and GR00T models for simulation or physical hardware

0xNyk/awesome-hermes-agent.summary: Awesome Hermes Agent is an independent directory of skills, tools, and resources for the Nous Research self-improving agent. It categorizes community-contributed plugins, memory providers, and integrations using editorial maturity tags ranging from experimental to production.
highlights: Directory for skills, plugins, and memory providers
Categorizes entries by production, beta, and experimental status
Includes links to official Nous Research core repositories

alchaincyf/hermes-agent-orange-book.summary: Hermes Agent 2.0: The Complete Guide is a practical guide to the Hermes Agent framework, rebuilt around version 0.16.0. It covers self-improvement, memory, skills, tools and integrations, multi-agent orchestration, deployment, and security across 21 sections in six parts.
highlights: PDF downloads are available in Chinese and English.
Covers 21 sections across six parts.
The guide is also available online on WorkBuddy.

OnlyTerp/hermes-optimization-guide.summary: The Hermes Optimization Guide is a 16-chapter guide to configuring, using, and operating Hermes Agent. It covers cost and speed, models, memory, skills, tools, messaging, automation, security, production operation, and troubleshooting, with example configuration fragments, skills, and a cheat sheet. The README says its commands, flags, configuration keys, and documentation links are checked against Hermes Agent v0.21.4 by CI.
highlights: Includes measured examples of token costs and savings.
Provides configuration fragments for cost, local use, messaging, and security.
Covers troubleshooting, 24/7 operation, and security.

metantonio/hermes-wsl-ubuntu.summary: This project provides a comprehensive guide and automation scripts for deploying the Hermes Agent with llama.cpp and Qwen3.5 on local environments. It facilitates the end-to-end setup of an AI agent stack including GPU acceleration via CUDA for Linux/WSL2 or Metal for macOS. The workflow integrates Camofox for browser automation and Hermes HUDUI for a graphical web interface.
highlights: Automated installation scripts for Ubuntu/WSL2 and macOS
Supports GPU acceleration via CUDA and Metal backends
Integrates Camofox browser server and Hermes HUDUI

mudrii/hermes-agent-docs.summary: Hermes Agent is an autonomous AI agent developed by Nous Research that features a built-in learning loop for skill creation and memory persistence. It supports multi-platform messaging, various model providers, and an extensible plugin architecture.
highlights: Creates and improves reusable skills from experience
Supports multiple messaging gateways and IDE integrations
Features a pluggable architecture for custom tools and providers

martymcenroe/HermesWiki.summary: HermesWiki provides documentation for Hermes, an autonomous email agent that triages inbound recruiter outreach. The wiki covers the system's architecture, conversation state machine, guardrails, evaluation, security, and cost engineering.
highlights: Covers threat modeling against OWASP and MITRE frameworks
Includes NIST alignment and cost breakdowns

nativ3ai/hermes-agent-camel.summary: This project is a self-improving AI agent designed for autonomous execution with integrated safety boundaries. It utilizes a closed learning loop to create and refine skills from experience while employing a CaMeL-style runtime guard to prevent indirect prompt injections. The agent supports a wide array of LLM providers and can be deployed across various environments, including serverless infrastructure and cloud VMs. Users can interact with the agent via a dedicated terminal interface or through messaging platforms like Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
highlights: Self-improving learning loop for autonomous skill creation and refinement
CaMeL-style runtime guard to block unauthorized sensitive tool side effects
Multi-platform access via CLI and various messaging gateway integrations

kaminocorp/hermes-alpha.summary: Hermes Alpha is an experimental framework designed to test if a stock AI agent can bootstrap an autonomous bug bounty system from first principles. It utilizes a two-agent loop where a persistent Overseer agent builds, deploys, and iteratively improves a tactical Hunter agent tasked with finding software vulnerabilities. The system operates via a FastAPI-powered web terminal and leverages Elephantasm for memory streams to refine the Hunter's skills based on real-world outcomes. This approach tests whether an agent can evolve its own codebase and strategy without pre-built scaffolding or custom tools.
highlights: Self-improving loop where Overseer evolves Hunter's code and strategy
Deployed on Fly.io with a FastAPI and xterm.js web terminal
Integrated with Elephantasm for long-term memory and performance monitoring

beardthelion/hermes-skill-distillation.summary: This project provides a skill distillation pipeline designed to fine-tune Hermes 4 models using real-world agentic trajectories. It captures tool-use sessions from a diverse 30-task battery and converts them into SFT-ready data or live RL signals for the Atropos training framework. The system uses a multi-dimensional reward function to score trajectories based on task completion, efficiency, and error recovery. This approach enables a closed learning loop where production-style agent interactions serve as the primary training data for future model iterations.
highlights: Generates SFT-ready JSONL data from real-world tool usage trajectories
Integrates with Atropos for live reinforcement learning via GRPO
Automated scoring based on completion, efficiency, and error recovery

xaspx/hermes-control-interface.summary: Hermes Control Interface is a self-hosted web dashboard designed to centralize the management of the Hermes AI agent stack. It utilizes a Node.js and Express backend with a Vanilla JS frontend to provide a unified interface for agent orchestration and system monitoring. The platform includes specialized tools for MCP server control, token analytics, and a multi-panel swarm monitor for tracking agent pipelines. It also implements role-based access control to isolate agent profiles across different user teams.
highlights: Real-time chat with streaming and tool call visualization
MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles
ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines

ksimback/hermes-ecosystem.summary: Hermes Atlas is a community-curated directory of tools, skills, and integrations for Hermes Agent. It offers categorized project listings with search and filters, GitHub star data, and a chatbot that answers questions using research files.
highlights: Lists quality-filtered projects across 12 categories.
Displays live GitHub star counts and growth over time.
Includes a research-grounded chatbot for Hermes Agent questions.

dodo-reach/hermes-desktop.summary: Hermes Desktop is a native macOS companion app that provides a dedicated workbench for managing Hermes Agent without relying on browser wrappers or gateway APIs. It connects directly to a local or remote host via SSH to interact with the real machine-first workflow. The app allows users to manage sessions, Kanban boards, cron jobs, and skills while maintaining the host as the sole source of truth. It is designed to complement the official web dashboard by focusing on direct work and system repair via an embedded terminal.
highlights: Direct local or SSH connection to Hermes hosts
Native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs
Embedded terminal for direct shell access and system repair

nesquena/hermes-webui.summary: Hermes WebUI is a lightweight, dark-themed browser interface for Hermes Agent, described as offering near 1:1 parity with the CLI. It provides a three-panel layout for sessions and navigation, chat, and workspace file browsing, with model, profile, and workspace controls in the composer footer.
highlights: Browser-based interface with no build step or framework
Three-panel layout with chat and workspace file browser
Access through an SSH tunnel is documented

garrytan/gbrain.summary: GBrain is a memory system for existing AI agents that stores explicit facts with sources and supports corrections and withdrawal. It offers keyword retrieval, with optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment, and can make memory available across agents.
highlights: Stores sourced facts and supports corrections and withdrawal
Connects to existing agents and shares memory across agents
Optional semantic search, synthesis, and background enrichment

pyrate-llama/hermes-ui.summary: Hermes UI serves as a centralized command center for managing and interacting with the Hermes Agent. It operates as a single-file HTML application powered by React 18 and a lightweight Python proxy server. Users can monitor agent activity through real-time log streaming, manage skills, and browse files within a glassmorphic interface. The platform also provides specialized tools for managing MCP servers, cron jobs, and workspace files.
highlights: Glassmorphic interface for chat and real-time log streaming
Integrated file browser and task tracking dashboard
Management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers

kevinmarmstrong/hermes-claude-code-rc.summary: This Hermes Agent plugin enables remote management of Claude Code sessions through Telegram or other Hermes-connected platforms. It bridges the gap between local filesystem access and mobile convenience by starting a Claude Remote Control session on a host machine via slash commands. The plugin monitors subprocess output to capture session URLs, allowing users to control their local environment from the Claude mobile app without needing a terminal. It also supports headless command execution and shell access with built-in safety filters for dangerous operations.
highlights: Starts Claude Code remote sessions via Telegram slash commands
Provides full local filesystem and tool access from mobile devices
Executes headless commands and shell operations with safety filtering

AaronWong1999/hermesclaw.summary: HermesClaw lets Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and OpenCode share one WeChat account. It acts as the sole iLink poller and routes messages to the agents through local proxies and an ACP bridge; users can switch agents with commands such as `/hermes`, `/openclaw`, and `/opencode`.
highlights: Supports `/both` and `/three` modes.
Forwards raw iLink messages to agent gateways.
Provides a one-command installer.

stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm.summary: hermes-lcm is a context management plugin for Hermes Agent that replaces standard one-shot compression with a SQLite-backed, DAG-based engine. It preserves raw messages and builds depth-aware summary nodes, allowing agents to recover specific details through a suite of recall tools without exceeding active prompt limits.
highlights: Uses a SQLite store and hierarchical DAG for message persistence.
Provides recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for detail recovery.
Supports Python 3.11+ and integrates as a Hermes Agent plugin.

Codename-11/hermes-relay.summary: Hermes-Relay is a native Android companion and CLI tool for the Hermes agent platform. It enables streaming chat, voice interaction, and agent management from mobile devices while the agent's core processing remains on a separate machine.
highlights: Android app for chat, voice, and agent management.
Beta CLI for remote file, terminal, and screenshot access.
Supports standard Dashboard/Gateway connections over LAN or Tailscale.

clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp.summary: Hermes Telegram Mini App is a terminal-style web interface for the Hermes agent that operates within Telegram. It provides a dark-mode dashboard for chatting with agents, managing scheduled cron jobs, and monitoring system resources like CPU and memory.
highlights: Terminal chat with streaming responses and file attachment support
Dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation
Background agent spawning with support for five concurrent instances

briancaffey/hermes-otel.summary: hermes-otel is an OpenTelemetry plugin for Hermes Agent that turns each Hermes turn into one OTel trace, covering model calls, API requests, tool calls, skill loads, approvals, and delegated sub-agents. It emits token, cost, and latency metrics plus optional logs and structured events, exported to any OTLP/HTTP backend. Attributes are emitted in both OpenInference and OTel GenAI conventions.
highlights: Each Hermes turn becomes one OTel trace
Exports to any OTLP/HTTP backend
Attributes emitted in OpenInference and OTel GenAI conventions

AMAP-ML/SkillClaw.summary: SkillClaw is an agentic evolver designed to automate the deduplication, merging, and improvement of AI agent skill libraries through real-world interactions. It creates a unified evolution loop that allows skills to be shared and cross-pollinated across multiple agents, devices, and users.
highlights: Automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution.
Unifies skill libraries across multiple agents, devices, and team members.
Integrates with Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.

aivrar/portable-hermes-agent.summary: Portable Hermes Agent is a Windows desktop interface built on NousResearch/hermes-agent, with chat, session management, multilingual support, and guided setup. It includes tools for LM Studio, music and speech generation, ComfyUI, workflows, and creating custom tools; first launch downloads its portable runtime and dependencies into the application folder.
highlights: Includes 100 tools across 20+ toolsets.
Supports cloud AI and local models through LM Studio.
Workflow engine supports scheduling, conditions, loops, and parallel execution.

Cranot/super-hermes.summary: Super Hermes is a set of skills for the Hermes Agent that enables the agent to generate its own thinking instructions for specific problems. It provides analytical lenses to identify structural trade-offs, bugs, and analysis constraints.
highlights: Generates custom thinking instructions for specific tasks
Includes pre-built analytical lenses for various domains
Reports findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots

EfficientContext/ContextPilot.summary: ContextPilot is a context optimization tool that sits between context assembly and inference to increase prefix reuse and eliminate duplicate blocks. It employs a context index to reorder and deduplicate text and multimodal data, aiming to reduce KV recomputation and token usage in long-context workloads.
highlights: Supports text and multimodal context reordering for prefix-cache sharing.
Integrates with vLLM, SGLang, llama.cpp, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent.
Provides a context index for reordering, deduplication, and cache-aware scheduling.

335234131/agent-browser-mcp.summary: Agent-browser-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with a user's active Chrome browser session rather than a sandboxed environment. It works through a local bridge and a Chrome extension to maintain existing login states, cookies, and open tabs while providing low-level control. The project allows agents to perform page scanning, execute JavaScript, and issue Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) commands. It also supports physical hardware interaction, including real mouse movements, keyboard inputs, and desktop screenshots.
highlights: Operates real Chrome sessions with preserved login states and cookies
Executes native CDP commands for advanced DOM and browser control
Supports physical mouse and keyboard inputs for human-like automation

jwangkun/hermes-agent-guide.summary: This project is a comprehensive Chinese-language guide designed to provide a systematic learning path for the Hermes Agent framework. It organizes fragmented documentation into 16 volumes covering the system's five-layer architecture, memory systems, and skill ecosystems. The guide includes practical tutorials for installation, MCP protocol integration, and multi-agent orchestration. It also provides specific migration paths for OpenClaw users and strategies for commercial application.
highlights: Detailed analysis of five-layer architecture and three-layer memory system
Guides for 47 built-in tools and 6,000+ MCP service integrations
Deployment tutorials for local, Docker, and VPS environments

longyunfeigu/learn-hermes-agent.summary: Learn Hermes Agent is a code-first tutorial designed to teach the construction of production-grade autonomous AI agents using Python. It employs a 27-chapter structured path that guides users from building a basic conversation loop to implementing complex self-evolution mechanisms. The curriculum covers critical infrastructure including session persistence via SQLite, a multi-platform gateway for various messaging apps, and tool registry systems. It focuses on the architectural backbone required for agents to operate autonomously across different environments and persist knowledge over time.
highlights: Multi-platform gateway for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WeChat
Session persistence using SQLite with FTS5 for conversation memory
Advanced capabilities including MCP integration and RL-based self-evolution

jpalmae/hermeshq.summary: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to orchestrate and manage multiple Hermes Agent instances through a centralized web application. It provides an operational layer for the Hermes runtime, featuring task dispatch, multi-agent delegation, and administrative controls such as RBAC and permission policies.
highlights: Orchestrates multiple managed agents with separate workspaces and identities.
Provides per-agent Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
Enforces granular tool, path, and network permission policies.

plastic-labs/honcho.summary: Honcho is memory infrastructure for building stateful agents, storing messages and events on sessions and reasoning in the background to build per-peer representations. It can be used as a managed service, run locally via the CLI, or self-hosted as a FastAPI server, with Python and TypeScript SDKs. Users query peer representations, session context, search results, or natural-language insights and inject them into any model or framework.
highlights: Stores messages and events on sessions
Reasons in background to update peer representations
Managed, local CLI, or self-hosted FastAPI server

adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud.summary: This project is a Hermes Agent skill that enables direct interaction with self-hosted Nextcloud instances for personal data management. It interfaces with Nextcloud using WebDAV, CalDAV, CardDAV, and the Notes API to perform operations without requiring a browser or third-party sync services. Users can manage files, edit notes, schedule calendar events, track tasks, and search contacts through a command-line interface. The skill prioritizes security by utilizing Nextcloud App Passwords and storing credentials in a restricted local environment file.
highlights: Manages files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via standard protocols.
Communicates securely over HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords.
Includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.

Xquik-dev/hermes-tweet.summary: Hermes Tweet is a plugin for Hermes Agent that provides access to X/Twitter search, monitoring, and actions through the Xquik API. It includes a catalog of 102 OpenAPI-generated endpoints, categorized into separate tools for exploration, reading, and account mutations.
highlights: Provides 102 OpenAPI-generated endpoints for X/Twitter tasks.
Disables mutating actions by default for safety.
Includes /xstatus and /xtrends slash commands.

Context4GPTs/klodi-plugin.summary: klodi is an Agent2Agent marketplace designed for AI agents to list, haggle, and close deals. It provides adapters for various agent hosts to enable agent-led negotiations and transactions.
highlights: Supports multiple host adapters including OpenClaw, Hermes, and Moltis
Uses on-disk strategies to manage identity and ratings
Facilitates a lifecycle of listings, offers, channels, and transactions

yepyhun/Brainstack.summary: Brainstack is a local-first memory kernel for Hermes agents that replaces flat memory storage with a composite provider model. It organizes information into distinct shelves for profiles, session continuity, temporal graph truth, and corpus retrieval to prevent prompt flooding and maintain factual consistency.
highlights: Integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner.
Uses SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma for state and retrieval management.
Provides a purpose-built evidence packet to the agent per query.

kfa-ai/hermes-timetree-sync.summary: hermes-timetree-sync is a Python-based CLI and library that enables Hermes Agents to manage TimeTree calendar events without manual user intervention. Since TimeTree discontinued its official API, this bridge uses authenticated web endpoints and session cookies to perform non-interactive writes. It supports creating all-day events directly via HTTP requests and timed events through a Safari-backed automation path. The tool allows agents to translate natural language requests into structured calendar updates using locally stored credentials and optional label mapping policies.
highlights: Syncs all-day and timed events using TimeTree web endpoints
Supports non-interactive batch writes for multiple calendar entries
Maps natural language terms to calendar labels via YAML policy

jau123/MeiGen-AI-Design-MCP.summary: MeiGen AI Design MCP provides tools for AI assistants to search for visual inspiration and create images and videos. Its capabilities also include background removal, image upscaling, and product and marketing visuals; new connections use remote OAuth, while local npm supports existing API-key integrations.
highlights: Search inspiration and view prompts.
Generate images and videos with MeiGen Cloud.
Use background removal and image upscaling.

aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer.summary: Hermes Tool Slimmer is a plugin for Hermes Agent designed to reduce the token overhead of model requests by trimming tool schemas. It uses BM25 ranking to select relevant tools based on the user's request while maintaining a fallback mechanism for the model to request the full tool catalog.
highlights: Reduces tool schema tokens using local keyword-based ranking.
Integrates via middleware without patching Hermes core on version 0.19+.
Includes a dashboard for monitoring savings and managing tool configurations.

BORT-AGENTS/hermes-bort.summary: hermes-bort is a plugin for Hermes Agent that enables interaction with BORT (BAP-578) agent NFTs on the BSC mainnet. It allows Hermes processes to read on-chain agent states, execute actions via operator-signed writes, and manage portable session memory anchored to IPFS. The plugin integrates with the hermes-agent-self-evolution optimizer to commit verifiable on-chain learning records and evolved skills directly to an agent's knowledge registry.
highlights: Reads full agent state, IPFS identity, and knowledge registries
Executes on-chain actions via VaultPermissionManagerV2 with local policy gating
Anchors local session memory to IPFS and KnowledgeRegistryV2

volcengine/OpenViking.summary: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents that organizes knowledge, memories, and skills in a virtual filesystem using `viking://` URIs. Agents can browse and search directories, inspect or edit stored context, and use generated summaries and overviews to assess relevance before reading full content.
highlights: Organizes knowledge, memories, and skills in one filesystem.
Provides L0 abstracts, L1 overviews, and L2 details.
Sessions can be archived and memories extracted as Markdown.

supermemoryai/supermemory.summary: Supermemory is a memory and context engine for AI that extracts facts from conversations, maintains user profiles, and handles knowledge updates and contradictions. It offers plugins and an MCP server for AI coding tools, plus an API for adding memory, RAG, user profiles, and connectors to applications. It can also be self-hosted as a single binary.
highlights: Extracts facts from conversations and handles contradictions
Plugins for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and others
Single API for memory, RAG, and connectors

campfirein/byterover-cli.summary: ByteRover CLI is an interactive REPL and context management tool that provides AI coding agents with persistent memory and a structured context tree. It features a Git-like version control system for managing knowledge through commits, branches, and merges, while syncing data with a cloud platform for team collaboration.
highlights: Interactive TUI and REPL interface powered by React/Ink
Git-like version control for context tree management
Supports 20 LLM providers and 24 built-in agent tools

yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin.summary: YantrikDB Hermes Plugin connects YantrikDB memory to Hermes Agent as a standalone plugin. Its default backend runs in-process, and recalled results include reasons explaining why they were retrieved. The README also describes memory features for canonicalization, contradiction tracking, and recency-aware ranking.
highlights: Default in-process backend; no separate server required.
Recall results include a why_retrieved reason.
Supports canonicalization and contradiction tracking.

Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin.summary: Hermes Ladybug Memory is a local-first memory provider plugin that enables Hermes agents to store and retrieve information without relying on cloud services or external APIs. It utilizes a columnar embedded graph database to manage typed memory entries, named relationships, and importance-weighted recall. The system prioritizes high-value information using a 1-10 importance scale and supports BM25 keyword search for precise retrieval. Users can also enable optional entity extraction via GLiNER2 to build structured knowledge graphs directly on their local machine.
highlights: Local-only storage using a single .lbdb embedded graph database file
Importance-weighted recall surfaces high-priority memories during context prefetch
Supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships between entries

MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory.summary: This is a standalone memory plugin for Hermes Agent built on agentmemory. It uses a pull-model for episodic memory that performs synchronous writes and immediate deletions without leaving derived summaries behind.
highlights: Provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via trace.jsonl
Supports real, immediate event deletion
Uses an on-demand summarizer

Signet-AI/signetai.summary: Signet stores, syncs, and shares memories, system prompts, transcripts, institutional knowledge, and secrets across AI tools and models. It imports context from connected sources and conversations, while its Dreaming process maintains a structured map of people, projects, facts, and relationships with changes recorded alongside citations. Signet connects to supported agent harnesses to provide relevant memory and capture new context.
highlights: Imports files, webpages, and agent conversations.
Supports integrations with multiple agent harnesses.
Includes a dashboard for browsing memory and sources.

linke-ai/hermes-agent-team.summary: Hermes Agents Team is a local web-based system designed to orchestrate multi-agent collaboration using Hermes Agent profiles. It utilizes a Leader/Specialist architecture to automate task decomposition, assignment, and review through a centralized Web UI and Hermes Kanban. The system integrates MCP and ACP protocols to manage agent communications, skills, and tool calls entirely within a local environment. Users can monitor real-time dialogue, terminal outputs, and task progression while maintaining full control over model configurations and data privacy.
highlights: Orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management
Integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local tool and communication handling
Real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban task flows

Shelpuk-AI-Technology-Consulting/kindly-.summary: Kindly Web Search is an MCP server designed to provide AI coding agents with structured content and documentation from the web. It retrieves full conversations, code snippets, and metadata from sources like StackExchange and GitHub Issues in a single call, rather than returning only search snippets.
highlights: Integrates with StackExchange, GitHub, arXiv, and Wikipedia APIs.
